title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-04-21
content:
Date: 2026-04-21
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #release-ops
Facilitator: Priya Raman
Scribe: Alex Chen

Attendees:
- Priya Raman (release engineering)
- Alex Chen (release engineering)
- María González (serving-runtime)
- Ethan Walker (SRE)
- Sofia Patel (platform eng)
- Ben Liu (QA)

Absentees:
- None reported

Agenda:
1) Status of current release train (v1.12.0)
2) Hotfix cadence and open hotfixes
3) Change log review and tagging for public release notes
4) Rollout plan for next week (canary -> regional -> global)
5) Blockers / postmortem follow-ups
6) Action items and owners

Notes / Discussion:
1) Current release train (v1.12.0)
- Canary deploy of v1.12.0 started 2026-04-20 22:00 UTC, routed ~2% traffic to canary pool in us-west-2.
- Initial telemetry: overall success rate 99.6%, p50 latency +2ms vs baseline, p95 shows +18ms in a subset of requests (long-seq workloads).
- María reported an unexpected kernel choice on a specific model variant causing KV cache thrash for sequences >2k tokens. Working hypothesis: kernel selection fallback not honoring quantized path for this variant.
- Decision: hold broad rollout until we validate the kernel selector fix in staging and run extended canary (48h) with synthetic long-seq load. Target: extend canary to 2026-04-23 22:00 UTC.

2) Hotfixes
- HOTFIX-1972: tokenization edge-case causing index error on empty-system prompts. Deployed hotfix to prod (hotfix channel) at 2026-04-21 02:15 UTC. Rollout verified; error rate for tokenization errors dropped to 0.001% from 0.15%.
- HOTFIX-1974 (pending): small regression in batching that reduces throughput under high-concurrency. Ben assigned to validate repro; if confirmed we'll cut a patch branch. Estimated risk: medium.
- Agreement: prioritize HOTFIX-1974 test matrix over the weekend. If failing tests reproduce, schedule emergency patch Monday AM.

3) Change log and release notes
- Alex to prepare the public change-log draft. Include: list of notable fixes (tokenization hotfix, streaming reliability improvements), performance notes (p50/p95 numbers for common models), and known issues (long-seq p95 regression under investigation).
- Docs owner: Alex Chen. Draft due 2026-04-22 EOD.
- Marketing/comms: link to Confluence draft for review (Confluence: release-notes-2026-04-21).

4) Rollout plan (if canary clear)
- Canary window extended to 48h per above.
- Regional rollout plan: after successful canary, roll to eu-west-1 and us-east-1 with 10% increments over 6 hours per region.
- Global ramp: 50% -> 100% with 1-hour observation gates.
- Automatic rollback triggers: error rate >0.25% for 15m OR p95 increase >30ms vs baseline for 15m.

5) Blockers / Issues
- Kernel selector bug (María): blocker for full rollout. Root-cause likely in orchestration logic that picks quantized kernel for certain model family. Need unit tests and a small runtime patch.
- SRE: There is a capacity planning mismatch for dedicated pools scheduled next month; Sofia to present updated numbers in next week's meeting.
- QA: Ben flagged flaky test-suite for the continuous-integration pipeline tied to batching changes. Flakiness must be reduced before branch freeze.

6) Postmortem follow-ups (from last incident RELE-330)
- Action: add more detailed tracing for model selection path. Priya to scope instrumentation tasks. Due 2026-05-05.
- Action: update runbook steps for cross-region rollback. Completed by Ethan; PR merged (see linked artifacts).

Action Items (owners and due dates):
- Priya: Coordinate kernel selector patch and schedule staging verification. Due: 2026-04-23.
- María: Implement unit tests for kernel selection and provide impact matrix for affected model families. Due: 2026-04-22.
- Alex: Draft public change-log and release notes, add links to PRs and known issues. Due: 2026-04-22 EOD.
- Ben: Run expanded test matrix for HOTFIX-1974 and report reproducibility + perf numbers. Due: 2026-04-24.
- Sofia: Present capacity plan and Dedicated pool forecast in next meeting (2026-04-28). Prepare slide with headroom targets. Due: 2026-04-27.
- Ethan: Validate rollback automation triggers and update canary alert thresholds. Due: 2026-04-23.

Decisions Made:
- Do not progress v1.12.0 global rollout until kernel selector fix validated in staging and canary extended to 48h.
- HOTFIX-1972 left as deployed; additional monitoring enabled for tokenization errors.

Risks and Mitigations:
- Risk: prolonged canary delays feature timelines. Mitigation: run partial region-specific performance tests in parallel and prioritize the kernel selector patch.
- Risk: flaky CI blocks branch freeze. Mitigation: triage flaky tests and temporarily quarantine non-deterministic tests; prioritize fixes for high-risk tests.

Next meeting:
- Weekly check-in: 2026-04-28 10:00 PT (focus: kernel patch status, HOTFIX-1974 results, capacity plan)

Appendix / Quick links:
- JIRA: RELE-342 (v1.12 rollout), RELE-350 (performance regression), HOTFIX-1972
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-engineering/pull/512
- Confluence runbook: release-runbooks-2026 (page-id: 8741)
- Slack: #release-ops thread (ts:1682064000.000200)

Notes to self / raw observations (informal):
- Quick repro script for long-seq perf available in /tmp/longseq-load-test (María).
- Need clearer labeling on model variants in the console so canary groups map to kernel profiles easily.
- Consider adding an automated daily mini-canary for long-seq workloads to catch regressions earlier.

End of notes.
